contributing: The seeded exercise catalog (F03). Edit by hand; keep one object per exercise and the key order below.
Never change, reuse or regenerate an existing id: ids are stored in lifters' databases, programs and alternatives. A new exercise gets a new random UUID (uppercase, e.g. from uuidgen).
Changes are additive: add entries, fix text, loads or alternatives; never delete an entry.
After any change, bump ExerciseCatalog.version by one and append '<version> <sha256 of this file>' to catalog.version.sha (shasum -a 256 exercises.json). ExerciseCatalogTests fails until you do.

Rules (checked by ExerciseCatalog.seed() and ExerciseCatalogTests): startLoad lb and kg are multiples of the equipment's default step (lb: barbell 5, others 2.5; kg: barbell 2.5, others 1.25), kg = lb converted and rounded to the kg step; loadKind 'bodyweight' exactly when both loads are 0; at least two alternatives with the same pattern, never the exercise itself; names and aliases unique ignoring case; shortName upper case, unique, at most 14 characters (it is the watch label).
Pattern rules and deliberate exclusions: see ExerciseCatalog.swift and tasks/features/F03-exercise-catalog/implementation-notes.md.
